description: Analyze policy documents (and optional behavioral decision logs) to detect contradictions, hidden rules, and gaps between declared policy and observed behavior. Stateless — no artifact is created and nothing is persisted. Returns contradictions of three types: rule_collision (two rules that apply to the same case with different decisions where the policy does not settle it soundly, each with that case and what the policy would do), ghost_term (an undefined standard such as "reasonable" in a rule's own text), and layer_divergence (a policy rule and a rule of practice that one case meets with different decisions); with behavioral logs, policy_gaps measured from the decisions.

behavioral_logs.description: Optional historical decision records. Enables layer_divergence detection — surfaces behavioral patterns that deviate from written policy.

items.description: One row of historical decision data.

documents.description: Policy documents to analyze for contradictions.

content.description: Plain text content of the document.

name: detect_contradictions

hidden_rules.description: Rules inferred from behavior not in written policy
